mapper.sql: (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM survey_plan sp JOIN survey_record sr ON sr.plan_id = sp.plan_id WHERE sp.factor_id = f.factor_id) THEN 'DONE' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM survey_plan sp WHERE sp.factor_id = f.factor_id) THEN 'DOING' ELSE 'TODO' END)
FROM vulnerability_factor f JOIN vulnerability_list l ON l.vulnerability_id = f.vulnerability_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.is_active = 1 AND l.sgg_cd = #{gu}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(x.status = 'TODO'), 0) todo , IFNULL(SUM(x.status = 'DOING'), 0) doing , IFNULL(SUM(x.status = 'DONE'), 0) done FROM (SELECT status ) x

SELECT vulnerability_id, user_id, sgg_cd, title, criteria FROM vulnerability_list WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sgg_cd = #{sggCd} AND is_active = 1 AND IFNULL(criteria, '') = IFNULL(#{criteria}, '') ORDER BY analyzed_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vulnerability_list (user_id, sgg_cd, title, criteria) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sggCd}, #{title}, #{criteria})

INSERT INTO vulnerability_factor (vulnerability_id, bld_id, is_applicable, vulnerability_score, vulnerability_grade) VALUES (#{vulnerabilityId}, #{bldId}, 1, #{vulnerabilityScore}, #{vulnerabilityGrade}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vulnerability_score = VALUES(vulnerability_score) , vulnerability_grade = VALUES(vulnerability_grade) , evaluated_at = NOW()
mapper.sql:
SELECT f.factor_id, f.vulnerability_id, l.title, f.bld_id , t.sgg_cd, t.emd_nm, t.addr, t.bld_nm, t.use_nm, t.lat, t.lng , CAST(f.vulnerability_score AS SIGNED) score , t.vuln_hh_cnt, t.priority_sum , factor_text , DATE_FORMAT(f.evaluated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') saved_at , status , (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM vulnerability_factor f2 JOIN vulnerability_list l2 ON l2.vulnerability_id = f2.vulnerability_id LEFT JOIN bld_resident_stat s2 ON s2.bld_id = f2.bld_id WHERE l2.user_id = #{userId} AND l2.is_active = 1 AND (f2.vulnerability_score > f.vulnerability_score OR (f2.vulnerability_score = f.vulnerability_score AND IFNULL(s2.vuln_hh_cnt, 0) > t.vuln_hh_cnt) OR (f2.vulnerability_score = f.vulnerability_score AND IFNULL(s2.vuln_hh_cnt, 0) = t.vuln_hh_cnt AND IFNULL(s2.priority_sum, 0) > t.priority_sum) OR (f2.vulnerability_score = f.vulnerability_score AND IFNULL(s2.vuln_hh_cnt, 0) = t.vuln_hh_cnt AND IFNULL(s2.priority_sum, 0) = t.priority_sum AND f2.bld_id < f.bld_id))) priority_rank , (SELECT sp.survey_id FROM survey_plan sp WHERE sp.factor_id = f.factor_id ORDER BY sp.plan_id LIMIT 1) survey_id , (SELECT sl.title FROM survey_plan sp JOIN survey_list sl ON sl.survey_id = sp.survey_id WHERE sp.factor_id = f.factor_id ORDER BY sp.plan_id LIMIT 1) survey_title , (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(sr.created_at), '%Y-%m-%d') FROM survey_plan sp JOIN survey_record sr ON sr.plan_id = sp.plan_id WHERE sp.factor_id = f.factor_id) checked_at FROM vulnerability_factor f JOIN vulnerability_list l ON l.vulnerability_id = f.vulnerability_id JOIN () t ON t.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.is_active = 1 AND (t.addr LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR t.bld_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
AND (t.pt_${k} > 0)
AND (t.pt_${k} > 0)
AND (
f.vulnerability_score >= 80 (f.vulnerability_score >= 60 AND f.vulnerability_score < 80) (f.vulnerability_score >= 40 AND f.vulnerability_score < 60) )
AND t.use_nm = #{use} AND t.high_iso_cnt > 0 AND t.old75_cnt > 0 AND t.severe_cnt > 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM survey_plan sp JOIN survey_record sr ON sr.plan_id = sp.plan_id JOIN visit_history v ON v.visit_id = sr.visit_id WHERE sp.factor_id = f.factor_id AND v.result IN #{vr})
AND f.evaluated_at >= #{savedFrom} AND f.evaluated_at < DATE_ADD(#{savedTo}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.use_nm FROM vulnerability_factor f JOIN vulnerability_list l ON l.vulnerability_id = f.vulnerability_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.is_active = 1 AND b.use_nm IS NOT NULL AND b.sgg_cd = #{gu} ORDER BY b.use_nm

SELECT f.factor_id, f.vulnerability_id, f.bld_id , CAST(f.vulnerability_score AS SIGNED) vulnerability_score, f.vulnerability_grade , DATE_FORMAT(f.evaluated_at, '%Y-%m-%d') evaluated_at , l.title, l.user_id, l.sgg_cd FROM vulnerability_factor f JOIN vulnerability_list l ON l.vulnerability_id = f.vulnerability_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND l.is_active = 1 AND f.bld_id = #{bldId} ORDER BY f.evaluated_at DESC, f.factor_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sp.plan_id FROM survey_plan sp JOIN survey_list sl ON sl.survey_id = sp.survey_id JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = sp.factor_id WHERE sl.user_id = #{userId} AND f.bld_id = #{bldId} ORDER BY sp.plan_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.record_id, r.plan_id, r.visit_id , DATE_FORMAT(v.visited_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') visited_at, v.result , v.user_id, u.user_nm, u.rank_nm , r.content, r.factor_check, r.score_adj , DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') created_at , t.dept_nm transfer_dept, t.req_type transfer_req, t.status transfer_status, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%m-%d') transfer_at FROM survey_record r JOIN visit_history v ON v.visit_id = r.visit_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = v.user_id LEFT JOIN transfer_log t ON t.transfer_id = (SELECT MAX(t2.transfer_id) FROM transfer_log t2 WHERE t2.record_id = r.record_id) WHERE v.bld_id = #{bldId} ORDER BY v.visited_at DESC, r.record_id DESC

SELECT t.transfer_id, t.bld_id, t.record_id, t.dept_nm, t.req_type, t.status, t.user_id, u.user_nm , DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') created_at FROM transfer_log t JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.bld_id = #{bldId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.transfer_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfer_log (bld_id, record_id, dept_nm, req_type, status, user_id) VALUES (#{bldId}, #{recordId}, #{deptNm}, #{reqType}, 'SENT', #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT m.memo_id, m.bld_id, m.from_user_id, fu.user_nm from_nm, fu.rank_nm from_rank , m.to_user_id, tu.user_nm to_nm, tu.rank_nm to_rank , m.memo, DATE_FORMAT(m.created_at, '%m-%d %H:%i') created_at FROM handover_memo m JOIN users fu ON fu.user_id = m.from_user_id LEFT JOIN users tu ON tu.user_id = m.to_user_id WHERE m.bld_id = #{bldId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.memo_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO handover_memo (bld_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, memo) VALUES (#{bldId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{memo})
mapper.select: SELECT b.emd_nm, SUM(x.status = 'TODO') todo, SUM(x.status = 'DOING') doing, SUM(x.status = 'DONE') done FROM (SELECT f.bld_id, status ) x JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = x.bld_id WHERE b.sgg_cd = #{gu} GROUP BY b.emd_nm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) cnt FROM survey_record sr JOIN survey_plan sp ON sp.plan_id = sr.plan_id JOIN survey_list sl ON sl.survey_id = sp.survey_id JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = sp.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id WHERE sl.user_id = #{userId} AND b.sgg_cd = #{gu} AND sr.created_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{months} - 1 MONTH) GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym
